preconditions.description: n is the number of clues (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5), m is the number of existing direct links (0 ≤ m ≤ 10^5), and k is the modulo divisor (1 ≤ k ≤ 10^9).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b for a, b in links)
preconditions.description: Each direct link (a, b) is between distinct clues (1 ≤ a, b ≤ n, a ≠ b).
The input contains exactly m direct links.

preconditions.expression: all((a, b) not in links and (b, a) not in links for a, b in links)
preconditions.description: No duplicate direct links exist (mutual links are counted once).

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer less than k.
The output is the number of ways to add exactly T direct links (where T is the minimum number needed to connect all clues) modulo k.
